_doc: Hidden territory monsters. 4 per continent (one per region, region = index of continents.json regions). Defeating one gives the player a Monster card: the monster joins that player's King when the King enters Last Stand in a Duel. Stats here are the wild stats; allies use balance.json monster_ally_stat_mult. buff.type is one of CardDatabase.BUFF_TYPES.

aetherion.name: Crownstone Golem

buff.name: Crownstone Hide
buff.desc: Takes 15% less damage.

aetherion.lore: A guardian of cracked marble that never left the throne road.

aetherion.name: Sunscorch Manticore

buff.name: Sunfire Sting
buff.desc: Attacks burn the target for 25% of ATK every 4 ticks for 12 ticks.

aetherion.lore: Stalks the sun-baked marches and sears whatever it bites.

aetherion.name: Vale Thornstag

buff.name: Briar Antlers
buff.desc: Reflects 20% of the damage taken back at the attacker.

aetherion.lore: A stag grown over with thorns; striking it hurts the striker.

aetherion.name: Dusk Keep Wraith

buff.name: Soul Sip
buff.desc: Heals itself for 20% of the damage dealt.

aetherion.lore: The last garrison of the Keep, drinking life from the living.

arcanum.name: Spire Arcane Sentinel

buff.name: Runic Ward
buff.desc: Starts with a shield worth 25% of max HP.

arcanum.lore: A construct sealed with wards by the first spellwrights.

arcanum.name: Cinder Phoenix

buff.name: Ashes Reborn
buff.desc: The first time it falls, it returns with 40% HP.

arcanum.lore: Burns to cinders and rises again once.

arcanum.name: Rimeclaw Yeti

buff.name: Rime Touch
buff.desc: Attacks slow the target for 5 ticks.

arcanum.lore: Its claws leave frost that slows everything it hits.

arcanum.name: Vault Shadehound

buff.name: Finishing Bite
buff.desc: Deals +30% damage to enemies below 30% HP.

arcanum.lore: Hunts the wounded through the Umbral Vault.

machina.name: Gearwork Behemoth

buff.name: Self-Repair
buff.desc: Heals itself for 5% max HP every 8 ticks.

machina.lore: A siege engine whose gears reknit after every blow.

machina.name: Voltage Arc Hound

buff.name: Arc Jolt
buff.desc: Every 4th attack stuns the target for 1 tick.

machina.lore: A dynamo beast that jolts its prey stiff.

machina.name: Chrono Foundry Drone

buff.name: Overclock Field
buff.desc: Adjacent allies gain +12% ATK.

machina.lore: Hovers over the forge and overclocks its allies.

machina.name: Nexus Grid Overseer

buff.name: Arc Lattice
buff.desc: Attacks also deal 35% damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

machina.lore: Its beams arc across the grid to hit nearby targets.

sylvaris.name: Canopy Elder Treant

buff.name: Verdant Pulse
buff.desc: Heals its whole side for 4% max HP every 8 ticks.

sylvaris.lore: An ancient tree whose sap mends its whole side.

sylvaris.name: Petal Dryad

buff.name: Bloom Song
buff.desc: Heals its whole side for 5% max HP every 8 ticks.

sylvaris.lore: A meadow spirit whose song makes wounds close.

buff.name: Cornered Fury
buff.desc: Gains +30% ATK while below 50% HP.

sylvaris.name: Rootmaw Behemoth

buff.name: Root Bulwark
buff.desc: It and allies within 2 cells take 20% less damage.

sylvaris.lore: Roots coil around it and its allies, softening blows.

drakmor.name: Spinewing Drake

buff.name: Dragonfire
buff.desc: Attacks burn the target for 30% of ATK every 4 ticks for 12 ticks.

drakmor.lore: A young drake that scorches from the ridge.

drakmor.name: Hellforge Infernal

buff.name: Forge Blast
buff.desc: When it falls, deals 80% of its ATK to adjacent enemies.

drakmor.lore: A demon of slag that detonates when it dies.

drakmor.name: Bloodfang Pit Fiend

buff.name: Blood Frenzy
buff.desc: Gains +8% ATK for each enemy defeated (max 5 times).

drakmor.lore: Every kill in the pits makes it hit harder.

drakmor.name: Warborn Ogre Warlord

buff.name: Warcry Charge
buff.desc: The first attack deals +50% damage.

drakmor.lore: Opens every fight with a crushing blow.

thalassia.name: Tempest Strait Leviathan

buff.name: Tidal Chill
buff.desc: Attacks slow the target for 4 ticks.

thalassia.lore: Its wake drags ships and warriors to a crawl.

buff.name: Many Heads
buff.desc: Attacks also deal 30% damage to enemies adjacent to the target.

thalassia.name: Abyssal Kraken

buff.name: Slippery Hide
buff.desc: Every 4th hit taken is avoided.

thalassia.lore: Slips away from every fourth blow.

thalassia.name: Corsair Cove Ghostcaptain

buff.name: Plundered Vigor
buff.desc: Heals itself for 15% of the damage dealt.

thalassia.lore: A drowned captain who steals the life of those he cuts.

buff.name: Rewound Moment
buff.desc: The first time it falls, it returns with 35% HP.

eclipsia.name: Paradox Echo Stalker

buff.name: Echo Step
buff.desc: Every 3th hit taken is avoided.

eclipsia.lore: Half a second ahead of every blow.

eclipsia.name: Eternal Hour Sentinel

buff.name: Frozen Time Ward
buff.desc: Starts with a shield worth 30% of max HP.

eclipsia.lore: Shielded by a held breath of time.

buff.name: Unmaking
buff.desc: Deals +35% damage to enemies below 30% HP.
